cd /opt/trading-bot/classic && grep -o '"sym": *"BNBUSDT".*"tf": *"5m"' runs.json | head -1; python3 <<'EOF'
import json
r = json.load(open('runs.json'))
bnb5m = [x for x in r if x['sym']=='BNBUSDT' and x['cfg'].get('tf')=='5m']
print(f'BNBUSDT 5m прогонов: {len(bnb5m)}')
if bnb5m:
    for x in bnb5m:
        print(f'  id {x["id"]}: {x["name"]} | сделок {len(x.get("trades",[]))}')
EOF
